contract: Preallocated shared inputs/private outputs. Same fused matrix and serial multi-dispatch reduction entries, one command with two encoders and scalar readback. Encoder-boundary timestamp sampling vs an uninstrumented control, two warmups/seven rounds, three randomized processes. Sampling can perturb execution; raw counter tick fractions require no clock-unit assumption. Full output and suffix checks plus an independent scalar oracle every round. Not managed language throughput and not instruction/occupancy/stall profiling. The device exposes only the public timestamp counter set, with stage-boundary but not dispatch-boundary sampling.
